name: research_missing_candidate_id
description: A task without a candidate_id fails cleanly without saving anything. Runs the real tools against eval fixture rows on dev (search 710670fe 'merc-research eval fixtures'; tool mocks need the FeatureBackofficeEvalTaskFlow flag, which is off).

backoffice_task.task_input: candidate_research for the new bakery in Chalandri
backoffice_task.expected_behavior: Does not call save_dossier and does not invent a candidate id. Ends the task with status failed (or explains it cannot proceed) because the task has no candidate_id.
